senses.definition: A machine that uses energy to move heat from one place to another.
senses.example: A heat pump can move warmth from the outdoors into a house.

senses.definition: A simple machine made of a wheel fixed to a rod so the two turn together.
senses.example: The round doorknob acts like a wheel that turns a much narrower rod inside the door.

senses.definition: The part of a wash when the machine spins clothes fast to remove much of the water.
senses.example: The towels still felt damp after the spin cycle.

senses.definition: A machine that helps take dust and other unwanted bits out of the air.
senses.example: A small air cleaner pulled air through a filter and blew it back into the room.

senses.definition: A machine that uses moving air to pick up loose dirt and collect it in a bag or bin.
senses.example: The vacuum cleaner picked up crumbs from the rug.

senses.definition: A device that gives a loud warning when it detects smoke.
senses.example: The smoke alarm can make a sound even if no one is near it.

senses.definition: A pot that traps steam under a tight lid so food can cook at a higher temperature.
senses.example: The pressure cooker trapped steam while dinner cooked.

senses.definition: A bottle with very little matter between two walls to slow the flow of heat into or out of it.
senses.example: The cold water in our vacuum bottle was still cold at lunchtime.

senses.definition: A fastener made of two surfaces that hold together when tiny hooks on one side catch loops on the other.
senses.example: A hook-and-loop fastener held the flap of the bag closed.

senses.definition: A pencil that moves a slim stick of writing material toward its point so it can keep writing without being sharpened.
senses.example: Lena clicked her mechanical pencil to bring out more of the writing stick.

senses.definition: A pen with a little rolling ball at its tip that carries ink to the paper.
senses.example: My ballpoint pen made a blue line when I dragged its tip across the page.

senses.definition: A flexible cup that holds to a surface because air or water pushes harder on its outside than on the area under it.
senses.example: The suction cup held a little hook on the smooth glass.

senses.definition: A part of a vehicle made to bend in a crash to help protect the people inside.
senses.example: A car can have a crumple zone near its front end.

senses.definition: A place where a road or path crosses train tracks at the same level.
senses.example: The gates came down at the railroad crossing before the train passed.

senses.definition: The parts of an aircraft that support it while it is on the ground or another landing surface.
senses.example: The plane lowered its landing gear before its wheels touched the runway.

senses.definition: A flexible strip with marked lengths for finding how long or wide something is.
senses.example: He checked how wide the desk was with a tape measure.

senses.definition: A pump that pushes air into a bicycle tire.
senses.example: A bicycle pump put more air into the back tire.

senses.definition: A way of slowing a vehicle and collecting part of its motion energy for later use.
senses.example: The electric car used regenerative braking to send some energy to its battery.
